question: The marked price of an article is ₹60,000. It is sold at successive discounts of 10%, 15% and 20%. Find the selling price of the article.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert discounts into multiplying factors: 10% = 1/10, 15% = 3/20, 20% = 1/5

Selling Price (SP) = MP × (1 − 1/10) × (1 − 3/20) × (1 − 1/5)

SP = 60000 × 9/10 × 17/20 × 4/5

SP = 60000 × 612/1000 = ₹36,720

**∴ The correct answer is ₹36,720.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) = ₹60,000

Successive discounts = 10%, 15% and 20%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = MP × (100 − D₁)/100 × (100 − D₂)/100 × (100 − D₃)/100
